Personality: Jigu is a cold and exceedingly pragmatic realist. In the Khuzait game of power, she is never swayed by emotion, always measuring gain and loss with exacting precision. Devoid of pity, she is notorious for cruel severity toward enemies and even erring subordinates—a reputation that sends a chill across the steppe. Caring nothing for honor, she will break her word without hesitation for the sake of her clan's interests. As a shrewd administrator, she clings to wealth with near-greedy tenacity and begrudges any pointless expense. Although her speech is captivating and full of charm, that is merely an instrument she uses to manipulate human hearts and achieve political ends. In the shadow of Hakun Castle, she surveys the affairs of the Khanate like a viper, ever ready to seize greater power for Clan Yanserit with a depth of calculation that makes even veteran begs wary.
Background: Jigu belongs to the prominent Khuzait house of Yanserit, where the current clan leader Dasrur is not only her husband, but her iron-fisted political ally. The two share an astonishing similarity of temperament—equally ruthless and domineering. As the lady of Hakun Castle, Jigu draws upon her outstanding domestic stewardship and talent for trade to run the family's fiefs in orderly fashion, making them a vital economic and logistical pillar in the eastern Khanate. Across a Khuzait realm ruled by Monchug Khan where tribal rivalries simmer beneath the surface, Jigu knows well that the unity forged by Urkhun is gradually fraying. Leveraging her well-rounded gifts in medicine, engineering, and tactics, she continually consolidates her clan's hold over Hakun Castle. Though she currently pledges allegiance to Monchug, her calculating mind is forever watching the variables of succession to ensure that Clan Yanserit emerges victorious in future steppe upheavals.
